##### Project General Facts

The Victoria project boasts a sophisticated design aesthetic, featuring exquisite exteriors that embody the essence of refined living, with premium three-bedroom townhouses that exemplify elegance and poise. These residences offer ample space, both indoors and outdoors, providing the perfect backdrop for creating lasting memories and a life of comfort, with beautiful layouts and state-of-the-art finishes. The townhouses present an exceptional living experience, with lush living spaces that seamlessly transition into private gardens, striking a perfect balance between elegance and functionality.

The Victoria project features an array of amenities, including private gardens, which provide a serene atmosphere for relaxation and entertainment, as well as a holistic living experience that caters to the needs of its residents. The emphasis on outdoor spaces and lush living areas creates a unique and desirable living environment, with an abundance of space for creating cherished memories. The private gardens offer a tranquil oasis, perfect for unwinding and enjoying quality time with loved ones, while the beautiful layouts and state-of-the-art finishes of the townhouses create a sense of sophistication and refinement.

The interior finishing of the Victoria project showcases modern finishing with high-quality materials, complemented by a timeless design that incorporates fresh, warm tones, and calm, relaxed atmospheres, which create a sense of serenity and tranquility. The kitchen is a masterpiece of design, with an emphasis on functionality and elegance, featuring state-of-the-art appliances that cater to the needs of discerning residents. With its exquisite design and luxurious finishes, the Victoria project offers a truly unique living experience that embodies the essence of refined living.


##### Location description and benefits

DAMAC Hills 2 is a haven of tranquility, nestled in a picturesque setting that offers a unique blend of natural beauty and modern amenities. The location is strategically positioned to provide easy access to four major highways, allowing residents to reach the city within a short drive. The proximity to major landmarks such as the Dubai Camel Racing Club, Dubai Miracle Garden, and Arabian Ranches makes DAMAC Hills 2 an ideal location for those seeking a serene and secluded living environment.

The surroundings are dotted with an array of amenities, including the Dubai International Airport, Mall of the Emirates, and Dubai Hills, which offer a wide range of shopping, dining, and entertainment options. The location is also close to several major roads, including Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, Emirates Road, and Al Qudra Road, providing residents with easy access to the rest of the city. The nearby Dubai Investments Park and Academic City offer a range of educational and professional opportunities, making the project an attractive location for families and professionals alike.

The community is designed to provide a unique living experience, with a range of amenities and activities that cater to the needs of residents. The community features a range of sports facilities, including a cricket pitch, tennis courts, and a football field, as well as a Zen Garden, a Waterside Cafe, and an Amphitheatre. The nearby Equestrian Town and Motor Town offer a range of exciting activities, including horse riding and go-karting, while the Community Mall and Supermarket provide residents with easy access to everyday essentials.
